C482 No.2359 of 2022
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Ajeet Kumar Yadav, Advocate, for 
the applicants.
Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Brief Holder, for 
the State of Uttarakhand.
Prior to issuance of notice to the 
respondent no.2. 
This Court feels it apt to direct the 
Government Advocate to file counter affidavit 
fortifying the fact, that the role of the present 
applicants, happens to be akin of Jeneva 
Talwar, who is also one of the co-accused 
persons in the FIR No.136 of 2020, whose 
C482 Application No.1641 of 2021, has already 
been dismissed by the judgment of the 
coordinate Bench dated 16.12.2021.
Put up this C482 Application as soon as 
the counter affidavit is filed by the Government 
Advocate. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 04.01.2023
